system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: You are an expert in model selection for anomaly detection on multivariate data.
system_prompt_style.note: Prompts are f-strings with dataset variables sent as user messages; the system message is commented out. Only the selector prompts were in the evidence.

env_context_strategy.note: Agent files were not included in the evidence. The selector prompt injects dataset statistics (name, size, dim).

context_compaction.note: The agent/pipeline code was not in the evidence bundle.

observation_format.note: execute_code returns a (stdout, stderr, returncode) tuple, which is text.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Provide responses in a strict **JSON** format with the keys "reason" and "choice."
tool_call_format.note: Generated scripts are executed in a sandbox (code_as_action). The selector answers in JSON.

tool_count.note: No tool registry was in the evidence. The pipeline passes between fixed agents. The paper mentions an OpenAI Web Search tool for Info Miner.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: is turned into a working script, executed in a secure agent environment, and evaluated end-to-end.
edit_primitive.note: The code generator emits complete scripts.

protocol_standardization.note: No dependency file contents were in the evidence.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: If issues are detected, the two agents enter a feedback loop, iteratively refining the code until a valid and executable pipeline is achieved.
loop_primitives.note: Fixed agent sequence: Processor, Selector, Info Miner, Generator/Reviewer. The Evaluator/Optimizer loop is optional (-o).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the system begins with the Processor, which interprets the user's input and pre-pares the data.
planning_granularity.note: Predetermined pipeline with no plan step. The quote may contain a hyphenation artifact.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: all through a coordinated pipeline of specialized agents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The short-term memory serves as the central workspace where agents read and write task-related content.
delegation_mechanism.note: Agents hand off through a shared state dict (build_state).

human_in_loop.note: main.py was not included in the evidence.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: The long-term memory caches model informa-tion retrieved by Info Miner.
long_term_memory.note: The cache format is unspecified; this is the closest value.

self_verification.evidence_quote: the Reviewer validates the code through a dry run using LLM-generated synthetic samples
self_verification.note: A dry run executes the code. An optional Evaluator is also available.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: iteratively refining the code until a valid and executable pipeline is achieved.
retry_policy.note: Code-level repair loop. Any cap is unknown.

termination_condition.note: The run loop was not in the evidence.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: the long-term memory serves as a cache to reduce costly queries across repeated sessions.
cost_controls.note: This is a web-search result cache, not prompt caching.

timeouts.note: Per sandbox execution; the timeout is passed to modal.Sandbox.create.

execution_isolation.note: A Docker container backend is available via --sandbox docker.

filesystem_access.note: Inside the sandbox; data is mounted at /data.

network_policy.note: No network/block_network argument is passed to Sandbox.create.

tracing.evidence_quote: print("[sandbox] Streaming sandbox stdout/stderr to this terminal")
